cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You've spilled paint on my sofa. Stay there; I'll get a cloth. We can fix this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Keep blotting. You're doing well. That carpet was my birthday present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right. Good catch. Take my clean shirt. I am absolutely furious, but you are not tackling this alone.

mechanism: A supplies increasingly exact cleanup instructions and encouragement while fury grows at damage to A own home.
confusable: Mere exasperated expertise need not support B emotionally; A must continue helping and praising while anger becomes unmistakable.
comparison: Birthday alternative manages a financial irritation in support of B wish, rather than guiding B through an accidental mess.
seedUse: Paint, carpet and improvised absorbent fabric come from D21-a; S03 shapes help through correction of rubbing, movement and sequence.
